features: ✅ 4K Ultra HD Action Camera with WiFi & Wide Angle Lens: Capture your adventures in 4K/30FPS with this sports action camera, featuring a 170° wide-angle lens and 16MP CMOS image sensor. Perfect for bike riders, helmet recording, motorcycle stunts, extreme sports, and YouTube vlogging in crisp detail.

✅ WiFi Connectivity + 2" LCD Screen for Live Preview: Easily connect the camera to your smartphone or tablet using the XDV App and enjoy real-time preview, playback, and sharing. WiFi range extends up to 33 feet, making it ideal for remote shooting and wireless content transfer to your devices.

✅ Multiple Resolution Options + Built-In Microphone: Record in 4K/60FPS, 2.7K/30FPS, 1080P/120FPS, or 720P, and capture 16MP high-resolution photos. The integrated microphone captures audio during action (audio performance may vary when waterproof case is used), making it a reliable helmet camera for bikers, vloggers, and content creators.

✅ 30M Waterproof Housing for Extreme Conditions: Comes with a durable 98FT (30M) waterproof case, allowing you to shoot videos and photos underwater—perfect for swimming, surfing, snorkeling, diving, and rainy conditions. Built for outdoor sports, beach holidays, and underwater adventures.

✅ Rechargeable Battery & Compact Design with Accessories: Includes a 1050mAh rechargeable battery, USB charging support, and multiple mounting accessories for helmets, bikes, surfboards, and more. Lightweight, portable, and designed for travelers, action vloggers, cyclists, and outdoor sports lovers.
